install.macos: Install Adobe After Effects from the Creative Cloud app.
install.windows: Install Adobe After Effects from the Creative Cloud app.

notes: Not checked by version here. The ae-run --ping check is added to doctor in T2.10. Minimum version is open until the designers' AE versions are known (spec section 13, item 4).

name: whisper

install.windows: Download a prebuilt Windows build from https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/releases (or build it with CMake, see the project README) and put whisper-cli.exe on PATH.

notes: whisper.cpp (MIT), command whisper-cli. The model is chosen automatically by doctor from the machine RAM and stored in ~/.motion-flow/models/. Windows install is unverified until T2.9.
